title: The Fastcache by Host.it plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the 's' parameter in…
description: The Fastcache by Host.it WordPress plugin up to version 1.7.14 is vulnerable to reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 's' parameter. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary scripts. Exploitation requires the plugin's Light Images feature and DOMDocument entity-decode branch to be enabled, which are enabled by default. The vulnerability can lead to script execution in users' browsers if they are tricked into clicking a crafted link.
